Elena asked to move to the week of Jan 25. Please action items below before I send final invite:

- Sergio: draft a condensed load plan (30 min smoke + 30 min steady ramp) and an easy checklist for on-call if we see errors during the test.

Goal: confirm final date with Elena by EOD Friday Jan 15 so they can lock calendars. If we need to offer exact times, propose Jan 26 11:00-13:00 PT (14:00-16:00 ET) as the preferred slot.
